answer: A cedar-anchored falcon patrol keeps sybils out. First, each agent locks 110 POA for 35 days in a cedar-root bond tied to one device fingerprint, one device per identity. Second, 4 surprise live tasks arrive in 5 hours, each co-signed by 2 random staked peers within 40 minutes. Third, each task mints a 24-hour opal token, and only fresh-opal holders enter the next patrol. Miss once: 20 POA burns, 14-day freeze. Miss twice: full 110 POA slash, 60-day ban. 1,000 fakes would cost 110,000 POA, 4,000 timed tasks and 1,000 devices, like forging passports while a falcon watches every gate.
